claims.evidence: 22 RAW files in PRIDE list, each claimed once; Skyline_wWT zip (SEARCH) not an SDRF data file.

claims.value: mouse<ID>_<skin|wound>_<ND|VAD>; normal chow diet vs vitamin A deficient diet
claims.evidence: Tissue and diet parsed from RAW file names (skin/wound, ND/VAD, mouse ID); paper: VAD from 4 to 10 weeks of age, controls on chow with same ingredients; ND taken as normal diet.
Unwounded skin vs wounds (5 mm punch biopsies). 'wound' is a label chosen for the wound state; not a disease ontology term check.
PRIDE organism NEWT:10090; paper: wild-type mice.
Paper: VAD experiments used wild-type C57BL/6 mice (in-house or Janvier).
Inferred: wound experiment at 10 weeks of age.
Sex not stated for the VAD cohort.
Index of mouse ID within diet group; skin and wound of same mouse share the number.
SureQuant (heavy IS-triggered targeted MS2 on Orbitrap); no SureQuant term exists, PRM chosen as nearest.
Protocol: Lys-C then trypsin; column is single-valued so trypsin recorded.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C Fixed; Oxidation M Fixed
claims.evidence: Data processing protocol (Skyline) states both as fixed.
Skyline MS1 filter mass accuracy 10 ppm; fragment tolerance not stated (resolution 60,000 only).
No sample labelling; heavy synthetic peptides are spike-in standards only.

limitations: Full SDRF built from PRIDE record, file names and open-access paper methods; RAW headers not inspected.
Mouse IDs, tissue and diet are parsed from file names; ND assumed to be the normal chow control.
Sex not available; age (10 weeks at wounding) not recorded as a column (not in contract); wound timepoint for SureQuant samples not confirmed (paper mentions 5-day wounds for DIA).
Heavy-peptide spike-in (500 fmol, JPT) not annotated in characteristics[spiked compound]: peptide sequences are in Supplemental Table 8 of the paper, not read.
Lys-C co-digestion not representable (cleavage agent single-valued); reconcile flags this as cleavage_agent_incomplete.
Acquisition method PRM is nearest PRIDE term to SureQuant; oxidation recorded Fixed as stated in Skyline settings.
